required_events.event: Amy stirred eggs in the bright kitchen while Will and Amber giggled over pancakes on the counter.
A groaning figure burst through the front door, shattering the window with its weightless hand.
She grabbed Will’s small hand and pulled Amber toward the basement closet, pushing them inside before a zombie lunged at her feet.
Amy stepped back into the kitchen, breathing hard, then slid a pistol from behind the cereal boxes in the pantry.
Her fingers closed around the cool steel; she flicked open its magazine and drew a gleaming katana from a hidden compartment beneath the stove.
She fired the pistol at the first zombie that staggered through the doorway, then sliced it cleanly with the katana as another lunged forward.
More zombies surged in, each dropping to her knees or slashing wildly, but Amy kept them down—one by one—with shots and blades echoing off the tiles.
When the last groaning corpse hit the floor, she ran back up the stairs, scooped Will and Amber out of the closet, and carried them together into the living room.
